newsitem.title: USA: Zomax Optical Media sees higher Q3 net.
newsitem.headline: Zomax Optical Media sees higher Q3 net.

text.p: Zomax Optical Media Inc said Wednesday it expects its net income for the third quarter to meet analysts' estimates of $375,000, or $0.09 a share.
A year ago, it had pro forma net income of $224,662 or $0.08 a share.
Shares outstanding have risen to 4.4 million in the third quarter from 2.8 million a year ago on a pro forma basis.
Sales for the quarter are expected to rise about 30 percent to $4.8 million, but be below analysts' estimates of sales of about $5.5 million, it said. Third quarter 1995 sales were $3.7 million.
Zomax Optical Media completed its initial public stock offering on May 7, 1996.

"We experienced some sales softness in July and August -- as did our industry in general -- but Zomax has seen a resurgence in its business to record sales levels in September," James Anderson, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement. "This should keep us at full capacity through November."
He added that significant gains in margins and profitability compared with last year reflect efficiencies gained by keeping nearly all production in-house.
Anderson said that, while it is too early to predict outcomes for the fourth quarter, the company expects further strong gains in net income on lower sales than currently estimated by analysts.
Zomax Optical makes high quality compact disc cassette and diskette duplications and offers related services.

"As part of our growth strategy, we are aggressively exploring acquisition opportunities," Anderson said. "While we are investigating these opportunities, we don't anticipate any acquisitions before year-end."
